sentences.text:
Nameeth Sharma & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 6
May, 2025
Item 06.05.

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 12 Appellate Side
Ct 22
 Crr 4842 of 2024

Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Malay Bhattacharya,
 Mr. Madan Mohan Roy.

1 . 
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No. 4280 of 2024 corresponding to Nagerbazar Police Station Case No. 173 of 2024 dated 25.06.2024 under Section 498A/ 406/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending before the Court of Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas.
2.

entities.text: Nagerbazar Police Station Case No. 173 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Court of Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that this case was falsely lodged even after an agreement between the parties and all Stridhan articles were sent to the house of the opposite party No.2.
3. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as well as having gone through the documents annexed with the revisional application, the same stands admitted.

4. Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner also prayed for stay of the proceeding involved in this revisional application, otherwise the very purpose of filing of this revisional application shall be frustrated.
6. Regard being had to the facts and circumstances in this case as it appears from the FIR and other documents, let the proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No. 4280 of 2024, pending before the Court of Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas be stayed Nameeth Sharma & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 6 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31617876/
1 for a limited period i.e till 31 st July, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
